notes.content:
:New Features
Added a feature that displays "New" on the tutorial in the start menu when there are unread tutorials.

:Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where pressing the "Auto ON/OFF" button during scenario playback would skip the scenario.
Various other issues have been fixed to improve the overall gaming experience.

notes.content:
//// Update Data Distribution ////

We have released a software update today. Please make sure to install the update before playing the game. For instructions on how to update, please refer to the support information pages for Steam.

Update Details:
<Steam (Ver.1.0.5)>
Fixed an issue where the title "X Challenger" was not being counted.
Fixed an issue where X Challenge could be completed in Online Battle.
Fixed an issue where X Challenge did not reappear in the third round.
Fixed an issue where the skill effects of characters using exclusive Xtreme skill were not displayed correctly on the information screen.
Fixed some other issues to make the game more enjoyable to play.

#BEYBLADEX #XONE

notes.content:
More letters can be entered for names.
Fixed a bug that caused unintended words to become NG words when entering a name.
The name can now be changed after the game starts.
Fixed a problem where the SE sound would continue to play when not matched.
Fixed some other issues to make the game more enjoyable to play.
